items.title: National Assembly Passes 2025-2026 Appropriation Bill After Marathon Debate
items.summary: The National Assembly has approved the D38.2 billion appropriation bill for fiscal year 2025-2026 following three days of intense debate on allocations for education and health.
items.author: Fatou Jallow

items.title: Scorpions Captain Named in CAF Team of the Year Shortlist
items.summary: National team captain Musa Barrow has been nominated for the CAF Team of the Year following an outstanding club season in Europe.
items.author: Lamin Ceesay

items.title: President Barrow Launches National Digital Transformation Strategy 2025-2030
items.summary: President Barrow has officially launched a five-year digital transformation strategy aimed at digitising all government services and expanding broadband to rural areas.

items.title: Inside the Banjul Port Expansion: A Visual Progress Report
items.summary: Eye Africa TV documents the ongoing Banjul port expansion project which will triple cargo handling capacity by 2027.

items.title: UTG Graduates Record 1,200 Students at 2025 Convocation
items.summary: The University of The Gambia has conferred degrees on 1,200 graduates at its 2025 convocation ceremony, the largest cohort since the institution's founding.
items.author: Ebrima Sillah

items.title: Morning Debate: Should The Gambia Adopt a New Constitution Before 2026?
items.summary: Freedom Radio's flagship programme hosts a heated panel discussion on whether the draft constitution should be enacted before the 2026 elections.

items.title: Kanifing Industrial Estate Attracts D500 Million in New Investments
items.summary: Three new manufacturing firms have committed D500 million in investments to the Kanifing Industrial Estate, expected to create over 400 permanent jobs.

items.title: Diaspora Investment Fund Reaches D50 Million Milestone
items.summary: The Gambian Diaspora Investment Fund has crossed the D50 million mark with contributions from over 2,000 Gambians living abroad.
